note: Recast from the redescription of S. translucens by Bourguignon & Roisin (2011), the original in English; the alate and the soldier (both large and small) are described; the original treats S. celebensis and S. marjoriae as new synonyms, and the measurements of the type samples are set alongside in square brackets.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Posterior margin of the head slightly rounded, with about 15 setae; eyes relatively large; pronotum with about 50 setae, mainly on the margins; antenna 20 segments. Measurements (mm, 3 individuals from the type colony; in square brackets 1 individual from the type colony of S. celebensis; in parentheses 26 individuals from 5 colonies): body length 7.31—8.95 [7.18] (7.02—8.95); head length to the anterior margin of the postclypeus 1.62—1.68 [1.54] (1.36—1.67); head width (including eyes) 1.72—1.76 [1.66] (1.63—1.84); pronotum length 0.88—0.98 [0.80] (0.74—0.89); pronotum width 1.48—1.55 [1.39] (1.30—1.56); forewing length 10.21—10.70 [n.a.] (9.60—11.40); eye major diameter 0.51—0.54 [0.41] (0.31—0.48).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Large soldier: medium-sized. Head slightly longer than wide, with about 30 setae; labrum not reaching the mandibular tips; antenna 16 segments; pronotum large, with about 15 setae; mesonotum and metanotum with about 10 each on the posterior margin; abdomen with 15—20 setae per segment; first marginal tooth of the left mandible slightly longer than the second; the inner side of the base of the right mandible with a distinct outward projection. Measurements (mm, 3 individuals from the type colony; in square brackets 6 individuals from one sample of S. marjoriae; in parentheses 87 individuals from 29 colonies): head length to the anterior margin of the postclypeus 1.91—1.97 [1.95—2.06] (1.45—2.10); head length to the labral tip 2.38—2.42 [2.40—2.58] (1.82—2.62); maximum head width 1.67—1.79 [1.75—1.89] (1.32—1.84); pronotum width 1.02—1.08 [1.04—1.12] (0.74—1.17); right mandible length 1.11—1.14 [1.12—1.19] (0.88—1.23); maximum postmentum width 0.27—0.30 [0.29—0.34] (0.20—0.34); hind tibia length 1.54—1.57 [1.42—1.53] (1.15—1.63).

Small soldier: head elongate with a rounded posterior part, with about 10 setae; labrum 2.5 times its width, reaching the mandibular tips; postclypeus elongate; antenna 15 segments; pronotum with about 10 setae on the margins; mesonotum and metanotum with about 10 each on the posterior margin; abdomen with 8—10 setae per segment; mandibles slender. Measurements (mm, 5 individuals from the type colony; in square brackets 6 individuals from one sample of S. marjoriae; in parentheses 10 individuals from 10 colonies): head length to the anterior margin of the postclypeus 0.99—1.19 [0.98—1.20] (0.90—1.11); head length to the labral tip 1.44—1.72 [1.49—1.67] (1.34—1.68); maximum head width 0.78—0.93 [0.78—0.87] (0.71—0.90); pronotum length 0.40—0.48 [0.35—0.46] (0.28—0.43); pronotum width 0.59—0.69 [0.52—0.63] (0.45—0.65); right mandible length 0.65—0.78 [0.60—0.72] (0.55—0.77); maximum postmentum width 0.30—0.35 [0.28—0.32] (0.24—0.34); hind tibia length 1.04—1.24 [0.89—1.02] (0.87—1.04).

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The original reduces both S. celebensis (Holmgren, 1911) and S. marjoriae Snyder, 1925 to new synonyms of this species, and compares the measurements of the type colony and the S. marjoriae sample side by side. In New Guinea it occurs at Madang, Morobe and elsewhere.
